keeper: unchanged qualified cuVS L2Unexpanded + CUB complete range + FP32 Euclidean fields + charged FP64 native-score observer + D2H
reference: ordered FP64 full scores; SCAN_MATCHED retained separately, not a native-FP32 comparator
calibration: disjoint from measured qids; pooled ordered-FP64 calibration squared scores rank floor(8*target_hits)-1; radius cast to FP32 sqrt once; report attained counts, no post-measurement retuning
N_protocol: same original Host query vectors and D960 radius on deterministic data prefixes; query may be outside prefix; no radius retuning

measurement.primary: median of six process-level mean query intervals; p10/p90 process distribution; raw 32-query totals and per-query observations retained
measurement.secondary: genuinely round-paired process log ratios, bootstrap 20000 seed2026101111; no promotion claim
measurement.profilers: independent diagnostic processes; never public latency denominator
measurement.workspace: fresh process; persistent build allocations excluded from query but separately recorded; warmup/model/workspace does not cross processes
measurement.GPU: one explicitly authorized idle single GPU; UUID, local slot and matching NUMA binding are private receipt parameters; do not change identity within a campaign
measurement.lock: existing two-sided-starttime guard, per-GPU shared lock; all processes serialized

roofline.sustainable: same-campaign native D2D CUDA-event combined read+write bandwidth and READ_ONLY read throughput disclosed separately; use larger calibrated streaming rate as reachable-memory reference, not a universal hardware maximum
roofline.traffic: NCU DRAM/L2/sector counters when supported, logical payload always distinct; one selected measured query main kernel, supporting output kernels via NSYS
roofline.proxy: 2,879 scalar operations/object at D960; exact FP32 instruction FLOPs only if counters support them

gates.MEMORY_BOUND: READ_ONLY/FULL>=.70 AND measured DRAM throughput/reachable streaming bandwidth>=.60 AND (FULL-COUNT)/FULL<=.15
gates.COMPUTE_BOUND: (DISTANCE-READ)/FULL>=.50 AND arithmetic execution/throughput evidence identifies saturated relevant pipe
gates.OUTPUT_BOUND: (FULL-COUNT)/FULL>=.30 AND high-vs-low selectivity cost growth CI lower>1.05
gates.CONTROL_BOUND: NSYS GPU active/Host query span<=.60 AND launch/sync/alloc dominates non-GPU time; inclusive API waits are not added to GPU spans
gates.UPDATE_BOUND: fixed336 workflow update ACKs>50% continuous trace and exceed query ACKs; no extrapolation to a long workflow
gates.NEAR_ROOFLINE: >=.85 reachable bandwidth or relevant compute AND output/control/update no single>20% fraction AND no controlled ablation shows>20% removable share
gates.priority: CONTROL, OUTPUT, COMPUTE, MEMORY, NEAR_ROOFLINE; UPDATE only after static phase and may supersede if its gate passes
gates.confidence: ratios from six paired process distributions; gate ratios primary point estimates, CI always disclosed; inconsistent order strata or unsupported counters leave classification inconclusive
gates.uncovered: record INCONCLUSIVE status and unmet criteria instead of manufacturing one of six labels; no mechanism design admitted
gates.ambiguity: MIXED is a diagnostic roofline annotation, not a final system-priority label; MEMORY resource binding and NEAR_ROOFLINE headroom are separate

stop: first runtime/isolation/quality/provenance failure stops formal stages; all failed and unexecuted jobs retained, no automatic replacement; compiler-only repairs before qualification are recorded
novelty: roofline/filter-refine and native brute-force scan are established; diagnostic kernels are not system innovations and no new thesis promoted
curation_note: Only device-placement prose is parameterized. Raw executed contract bytes/hashes remain private; this public file is not the original registration.
